description: Data underlying the publication: Multi-stakeholder service life design for rail level crossings is a data set deposited in 4TU.ResearchData by its authors Yue Shang. The data and code files are developed as part of Yue Shang's PhD Thesis project, which is also attached to the publication titled Multi-stakeholder service life design for rail level crossings (doi: 10.1201/9781003323020-115). It is being made public as supplementary data for the thesis of Yue Shang for review and reproduction purposes. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2024. Formats: MATLAB. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is Apache-2.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-4tu-repository.
